hook: PALACES BY DAY, NEON BY NIGHT
intro: Seoul is a 600 year old capital that runs on 5G, and dinner can cost five dollars.
facts: Start at Gyeongbokgung, the main royal palace from 1395, catch the changing of the guard, and rent a hanbok nearby so your ticket is free.
Walk up into Bukchon Hanok Village, a hillside of 600 year old tiled roof houses where people still live, so keep your voice down in the alleys.
For lunch go to Gwangjang Market, over 100 years old, and eat mung bean pancakes and knife-cut noodles at the stalls with the longest lines.
Ride the cable car up Namsan to N Seoul Tower at dusk, hang a love lock on the fence, and watch the lights of 25 million people come on.
End at the Han River with fried chicken and beer delivered to your picnic mat, the most Seoul thing you can do.
outro: Save this for your Seoul trip.
